articles.summary: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 15, 2017 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Methanex Corporation (TSX:MX) (NASDAQ:MEOH) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.30 per share. The dividend will be payable on December 31, 2017 to holders of common shares of record on December 17, 2017. Methanex is a Vancouver-based, publicly traded company […]
